# Penguino

> Penguino is a free collection of private, browser-based creative and file utilities. Processing happens locally on the user's device without an account or backend upload wherever possible.

Canonical website: https://www.penguino.app/

## Creative Tools

- [Text Graphic](https://www.penguino.app/text-graphic): Create branded text-only graphics with Google Fonts, reusable colour swatches, exact pixel sizing, transparency and PNG, JPEG or WebP export.
- [Colour Palette Extractor](https://www.penguino.app/colour-palette-extractor): Extract four, six or eight prominent colours from an image, copy HEX values and download the palette as CSS custom properties.
- [Favicon Generator](https://www.penguino.app/favicon-generator): Generate browser favicons, an Apple Touch icon, Android icons, a web app manifest and installation markup from one image.

## Image Tools

- [Image Resizer](https://www.penguino.app/image-resizer): Resize one PNG, JPEG or WebP by width, height or exact dimensions with aspect-ratio and quality controls.
- [Bulk Image Resizer](https://www.penguino.app/bulk-image-resizer): Resize up to 10 PNG, JPEG or WebP images using shared settings and download the results as a ZIP archive.
- [Image Optimiser](https://www.penguino.app/image-optimiser): Compress PNG, JPEG and WebP images with adjustable quality, file-size comparison and a before-and-after preview.
- [File Converter](https://www.penguino.app/file-converter): Convert image files between PNG, JPEG and WebP with transparency and quality support where available.
- [Background Remover](https://www.penguino.app/background-remover): Remove connected solid or simple backgrounds, refine tolerance and edge softness, and export a transparent PNG.
- [Metadata Remover](https://www.penguino.app/metadata-remover): Inspect and remove readable EXIF, GPS, IPTC and XMP metadata from PNG, JPEG and WebP images, then verify the clean copy.

## File And PDF Tools

- [File Packer](https://www.penguino.app/file-packer): Bundle up to 50 files or 500 MB into a named ZIP archive with optional filename prefixing.
- [PDF Compressor](https://www.penguino.app/pdf-compressor): Reduce PDF file size locally using selectable compression levels. Compressed pages are rebuilt as images.

## Site Pages

- [Home](https://www.penguino.app/): Browse every available Penguino tool.
- [About](https://www.penguino.app/about): Learn why Penguino exists and about its creator, Jon Whitby of StudioJWD.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.penguino.app/terms): Read the terms for using Penguino.
- [Settings](https://www.penguino.app/settings): Manage browser-based Penguino preferences.

## Privacy And Processing

- Files are processed in the browser and are not uploaded by the current tools.
- Brand presets, editor preferences and saved drafts use local browser storage.
- No account is required.
- Users should review generated files before relying on them, particularly compressed PDFs and automated background removal.

## Formats And Limits

- Image input and export formats include PNG, JPEG and WebP where supported by the selected tool.
- Text graphics can be exported as PNG, JPEG or WebP, including transparent PNG and WebP.
- Bulk image resizing accepts up to 10 images per batch.
- File Packer accepts up to 50 files or 500 MB per archive.

## Ownership

Penguino is built and maintained by [StudioJWD](https://studiojwd.com/).
